::: {#def-pretraining}

#### Pretraining

**Pretraining** trains a network on unlabelled data,
using targets that come from the data itself.
@radford2018improving [section 3.1] pretrain a Transformer with a [causal mask](#def-causal-mask) to predict each next token.
@devlin2019bert [section 3.1] pretrain one without a [causal mask](#def-causal-mask) to predict tokens hidden from its input,
choosing 15% of the positions at random.
Both then [fine-tune](cnns.qmd#def-fine-tuning) the pretrained network on tasks with labels.

:::
